spans.s: lañcaka, adj. (Pali id., ifc.), excellent, fine: kasyetaṃ (v.l. ˚yaitaṃ) nimittaṃ, lañcakaṃ (v.l. lambakaṃ) pāpakaṃ vā Mv 〔ii.421.8〕, what does this predict? (is it) good or bad?; sarvāṇi lañcakāni 〔467.7〕, all fine; also v.l. for (nara-)lambaka Mv 〔i.191.5〕 (mss. evenly divided). See s.v. lambaka.
